## Problem statement

Describe the problem or limitation you are trying to solve. Be specific about
the use case.

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature you would like to see. Include:

- How it would work from a user perspective.
- Any API or configuration changes required.
- Which existing components would need to change.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any alternative approaches or workarounds you have considered and
why you ruled them out.

## Additional context

Add any other context, references, or examples that would help evaluate this
request.
